Describe the concrete problem and resulting behavior. Link the issue or pinned upstream contract.

## Validation

- [ ] Relevant local checks pass; record commands and results.
- [ ] CI passes on the final reviewed head.
- [ ] Independent review covers that exact head.
- [ ] Parity evidence and unsupported behavior are accurate.
- [ ] For component changes: SSR/hydration, state updates, cleanup, cancellation, callback ordering and relevant browser acceptance are covered.
- [ ] Upstream-derived materials preserve their license notices.

Record any checks not run and why. Publication or deployment requires a separate approval.
